item.title: Why The British Painted Some WW2 Planes Pink
item.description: It’s MOUNTBATTEN! British aircrews experimented with an unusual camouflage technique during the early years of World War II. Some reconnaissance aircraft were painted in a pale pink shade that blended with the sky at dawn.
